notes: Research-based roundup; no hands-on claims. All facts came from search-result summaries of the sources listed (WebFetch could not reach any site in this session), so spot-check: (1) Baileigh RDB-175 conflicts are flagged in the text: mild steel wall .120 (product page) vs .125 (manual), max bend ~180 (copy) vs 205 (spec table); manual lists 2 HP 115 VAC 18 A and 700 lb shipping weight. (2) Baileigh RDB-050 190 vs 200 deg flagged. (3) Rogue Fab M605 wall .188 vs .250 flagged. (4) Rogue Fab mandrel wall-ratio trigger is 20 on the exhaust page but 15 on the mandrel-bending page; both mentioned. (5) NHRA TIG-for-4130 is attributed to the 2019 General Regulations only; the current 2026 rulebook wording was NOT verified. (6) SCCA Time Trials 3x CLR and one-piece hoop wording came from search summaries of timetrials.scca.com; re-verify the live page. (7) As the hub, it links 6 article slugs: best-tube-bender-for-home-garage, best-tube-bender-for-roll-cage, best-tube-bender-for-chromoly, best-exhaust-pipe-bender, best-hydraulic-tube-bender, cnc-tube-bending. (8) Eastwood High Capacity OD range: Amazon says 3/4-2 in, Eastwood's air-hydraulic page says 1-2 in, so the article only says 'up to 2 in'.
